decision: A separate prospective candidate can distinguish the actual +0 device-expression result and omit the zero-branch second barrier/present rewrites for that result. No implementation or runtime approval follows from this scout.
scope: Read-only accepted E020 plus closed E036 source/evidence and already retained D067 sign-count report. No new production code, compiler, native process, GPU work or census.

source_argument.detail: Require the entire logical opponent row to contain raw +0 bits, not numerical equality/sum0 or just sorted entries, and all three actual f32 payoff words finite. Preserve initial reach/card-position staging and first publication collective. Nonzero, -0, Inf/NaN reach or nonfinite payout goes through the byte-exact original fallback.

source_argument.point: Compute and classify the actual expression
source_argument.detail: After eligibility, win/lose/tie and +0 lower/higher/tied are identical in every thread of the CTA. Evaluate the same win*lower + lose*higher + tie*tied expression and classify its actual device f32 bits; only0x00000000 permits the shortened path. Do not substitute a host sign classification, real-number0, x==0 or a reassociated expression. Keep existing compilation options.

source_argument.point: The positive-zero path has no remaining intra-CTA dependency
source_argument.detail: Keep the full logical own-row +0 store loop. Every index i has exactly one writer from the threadIdx.x/128 strided partition. If every present-hand result is also exact+0, these stores already establish both present and absent outputs. No later same-CTA read or overwrite follows, so a post-store CTA barrier adds no required ordering before uniform return. Other active terminal CTAs have distinct persistent CFV slots, and later consumers remain behind the existing stream/captured-kernel dependency.

For0x80000000, absent hands still require+0 while present p_idx hands require-0. Keep full-row zeroing, the mandatory CTA barrier, then the original present-hand expression/writes. Sorted p_idx and logical zeroing can assign different lanes to the same address; removing this barrier on that path would introduce a write race.

Within the existing finite zero-input branch, compute the identical uniform zero-mass expression and test its bits after the existing full-row store loop, before the existing second barrier. Exact+0 returns; other bits retain the barrier/present path. Keep its original expression rather than forcing a sign-derived constant. No host, ABI, launch, shared-memory, fallback, other-kernel or card-preload changes.

source_locations.role: accepted up_show ABI, full-row+0 stores and sorted present result expression
closed E036 eligibility, first collective, full-row stores, mandatory second barrier and present writes
unique persistent terminal CFV slots, complete planned terminal lists and existing slot geometry assertions
evaluation/training up_show use the same three payoff arrays and existing ordered stream launches

existing_runtime_evidence.what_it_proves: Executed E036 cases matched accepted old up_show and asserted eligible present signed zeros/absent+0 with cross-lane coverage. This does not execute or validate the proposed early return.

existing_sign_count_evidence.meaning: Sign pattern is win,lose,tie sign bits. The count report is bound/read and its historical references are hash-checked here, not independently recounted. It evaluates no device expression and supports no timing, lifetime-frequency or speed claim.

minimal_future_test_obligations: Reuse the fixed E03634-pair/68-launch original-GPU reference unit with the new candidate, preserving both orientations, partial/full/empty sorted lists, nonzero starts/slots, count0, poisoned complete output/padding and all21 readonly input checks.

Keep explicit present+0 checks for mixed/positive-zero cases and present-0 versus absent+0 checks for all-negative finite/all-negative-zero cases with actual cross-lane p_idx witnesses; both classified result paths must remain covered.

Keep the excluded tail -0/nonzero/Inf/NaN and three nonfinite payoff-channel cases. Source review must verify exact bitwise eligibility and fallback suffix; direct equality alone does not prove excluded cases took fallback.

Any later separately authorized production experiment still uses the unchanged primary exact18/138 and >=2%/fixture guards, with conditional broader qualification only on pass. No extra E036 samples, timing exclusions or modified acceptance threshold.
limitations: Additional expression evaluation and a uniform bit branch have cost; the first collective, full logical-row staging, card-position preload and full-row stores remain. Removed source operations or incidence are not a complete-cycle bound.
New code may compile differently, including floating contraction; exact source expression and matching options plus actual old-GPU comparison remain necessary. No universal NaN-payload claim is made.

The no-second-barrier reasoning assumes current accepted unique terminal CFV slots, valid nonaliasing metadata, immutable payoff inputs and existing ordered consumers; it does not apply to arbitrary aliases or concurrent writers.
Whole-row incidence comes from historical sampled plan-derived joins; it is not new device metadata, current-strategy content or a new solve.

official_documentation.support: Kernel completion makes its global-memory results available for later kernels/host copies. This supports the source inference that no terminal CTA barrier is needed solely to publish final unique stores.
CTA barriers coordinate conflicting cross-thread memory accesses. The -0 route retains that dependency; the +0 return route has no later conflicting access.
Floating operation ordering and FMA choices can affect exact results. Preserve the device expression/options and test actual bits rather than using a host arithmetic substitute.
